label: D2 step showing state S2, late in the episode (trial >= ~82)
explanation: Fires only at D2 and only when the reached state shown is S2 (100% of activation mass at D2 with in_state=S2). It never fires on D1, GO, or S1 at D2. A second gate is the episode clock: it is silent before episode trial ~75, and its rate rises from 0.7% (trials 70-79) to 8.7% (80-89) and 14% (90-99). Adding ep_trial >= 82 gives dev P=0.69, R=0.93, F1=0.79, mass recall 0.98. Most mass (92%) is on common a2->S2 transitions, but requiring action==2 lowers F1, so rare a1->S2 trials count too. Activation is also strongly associated with low model value (74% of mass in the bottom value bin), which is consistent with the late-episode effect. The remaining false positives are late S2 D2 steps where it stays silent. Strong activations seem to come in runs of repeated a2->S2 trials, but I did not quantify this. Reward, stay/switch and the good state add little. Every variable used is observed at D2 (the reached state is shown as input, and the trial count is implicit in elapsed time). No future variables are used.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over this trial (D2: a2 S2, a1 S2) and last trial (D2: a1 S2 r, a1 S2 u, a2 S2 r); timing cues that raise it most: phase=D2 & ep_dec=9, phase=D2 & ep_dec=8, phase=D2 & ep_dec=7.
